note: Tech Bila Hype — TANGAZO: Altraware × BongoFoodie (2026-11-18). A sponsored tangazo for Altraware's software service (apps + websites for Tanzanian businesses), using BongoFoodie as the live proof — not a BongoFoodie-only ad, not a tech-bro ad. Same rig and motion grammar as EP.1/EP.2 (voice-led cut, kit visemes, safe-box poses); new copy around what Altraware makes. Kiswahili VO, scratch TTS for review — the owner records his own read for the final (copy.json is the record of the exact words). The screenshot exports under assets/ are the owner's own product (bongofoodie.vercel.app, DEMO admin view); dashboard figures on screen match the demo screenshot exactly and are labelled DEMO in the picture.

en: Welcome to Tech Bila Hype. Today is an ad — short, but heavy.
takes.say: Karibu Tech Bila Hype. Leo ni tangazo — fupi, zito.

sw: Biashara nyingi Tanzania: chakula kizuri, huduma nzuri —
lakini orders zinapotea kwenye simu, WhatsApp na makaratasi.
en: Many businesses in Tanzania: good food, good service — but orders disappear into calls, WhatsApp and paper.
takes.say: Biashara nyingi Tanzania: chakula kizuri, huduma nzuri — lakini orders zinapotea kwenye simu, WhatsApp na makaratasi. Hakuna anayeona menu mtandaoni.

sw: Menu mtandaoni, bei wazi. Nyama Choma TSh 13,500. Chipsi Mayai TSh 5,500. Order moja kwa moja kutoka sofa — mpaka jikoni.
en: BongoFoodie — the app and website we built. The menu online, prices clear. Nyama Choma at 13,500. Chipsi Mayai at 5,500. Order straight from the sofa — to the kitchen.
takes.say: BongoFoodie — app na website tuliyoujenga. Menu mtandaoni, bei wazi. Nyama Choma TSh 13,500. Chipsi Mayai TSh 5,500. Order moja kwa moja kutoka sofa — mpaka jikoni.

sw: Nyuma ya pazia: orders zinaingia moja kwa moja.
Leo: TSh 92,500, maorder matatu, moja inasubiri jikoni. Na Chef AI anajibu wateja papo hapo.
en: Behind the curtain: orders come in automatically. Today: 92,500 shillings, three orders, one waiting in the kitchen. And Chef AI answers customers instantly.
takes.say: Nyuma ya pazia: orders zinaingia moja kwa moja. Leo: TSh 92,500, maorder matatu, moja inasubiri jikoni. Na Chef AI anajibu wateja papo hapo.

sw: app yako, website yako, menu ya digital, Chef AI yako mwenyewe — mwanzo hadi mwisho. Altraware.
en: What we can do for your business: your app, your website, your digital menu, your own Chef AI — start to finish. Altraware.
takes.say: Tunachoweza kufanya kwa biashara yako: app yako, website yako, menu ya digital, Chef AI yako mwenyewe — mwanzo hadi mwisho. Altraware.

sw: Biashara yako inahitaji app au website?
altra.tanzaniareach.com — au comment APP. Altraware — tunatengeneza.
en: Does your business need an app or a website? altra.tanzaniareach.com — or comment APP. Altraware — we build.
takes.say: Biashara yako inahitaji app au website? altra.tanzaniareach.com — au comment APP, nitakutumia ujumbe. Altraware — tunatengeneza.
